The '''1882 Canadian federal election''' was held on June 20, 1882, to elect members  of the [[House of Commons of Canada]] of the [[5th Canadian Parliament|5th Parliament]] of [[Canada]].

[[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] Sir [[John A. Macdonald]]'s [[Conservative Party of Canada (historical)|Conservatives]] and [[Liberal-Conservative Party|Liberal-Conservative]]s retained power, defeating the [[Liberal Party of Canada|Liberal Party]] of [[Edward Blake]].

'''Acclamations:'''

The following Members of Parliament were elected by acclamation;
* British Columbia: 2 Liberal-Conservatives
* Manitoba: 1 Conservative
* Ontario: 2 Conservatives
* Quebec: 11 Conservatives, 1 Independent Conservative, 4 Liberal-Conservatives, 3 Liberals
* New Brunswick: 1 Liberal-Conservative, 1 Independent
* Nova Scotia: 1 Conservative
